title: Simulate blazed grating without back reflector
action: Set up FDTD simulation for a blazed grating on a 1 µm tungsten substrate (period 200 nm, height 285 nm, blaze angle 55°). Use Bloch periodic boundaries laterally, PML vertically. Model tungsten dielectric function with a Drude+Lorentzian fit. Average P- and S-polarized reflectance to approximate unpolarized light. Simulate the reflectance spectrum over the wavelength range required for the spectral efficiency integral (0.3–5 µm).
description: Reflectance spectrum of the blazed grating emitter without a back reflector.

title: Simulate blazed grating with perfect back reflector
action: Repeat the same FDTD simulation as step sim_no_reflector but place a perfect electric conductor (PEC) back reflector behind the 1 µm tungsten substrate. Record the reflectance spectrum over 0.3–5 µm.
description: Reflectance spectrum of the blazed grating emitter with a perfect back reflector.
